items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: we were on the Garry Moore show a couple of times and did a drum thing together with Garry

ctx.x: Yeah, see, and I just went on and did my thing and he done his thing, you know, because we did several things on the Tonight Show before Johnny Carson got it—Steve Allen—we were on there and did a thing together. We were on there. Then we were on the Garry Moore show a couple of times and did a drum thing together with Garry. Gene gave Garry a whole full set of drums.
